statements.impact_statement: ClamAV can pass uploaded documents through libxml2. The finding is a use-after-free denial of service, not remote code execution, and Debian has published no fixed package for this version. Authenticated upload size is limited, the daemon is not published, a scan error becomes SCAN_FAILED, and the process is non-root with no-new-privileges. This is an explicit MVP release risk until the next official image rebuild. Review on 2026-10-30.
statements.author: QC-ControlDana release engineering
statements.evidence: Trivy FixedVersion is empty. ClamAV command path is clamd TCP 3310. Caddyfile limits request bodies to 22MB.

This is an explicit MVP release risk until the next official image rebuild. Review on 2026-10-30.

statements.impact_statement: The defect requires an OpenSSL QUIC listener that accepts QUIC Initial packets faster than the application consumes connections. statements.author: QC-ControlDana release engineering
statements.evidence: clamd listens on TCP 3310. Caddyfile.production sets protocols h1 h2 and does not use OpenSSL.

statements.evidence: Own images start node and remove /bin/sh. Vendor daemons do not shell out to perl, gpg, ncurses, or systemd-homed for client traffic.
